title: Paper-1 v03r end-to-end organism canary v1c
summary: Preserve the narrow v03r canary while resolving v1b's unreachable goal/intervention order and underbound recurrence, proposal admission, path controls, thinker read projection, LoRA training, validity, and review authority. A proposal is now audit state until one blind model self-check; only model-supported proposals become immutable memory rows.
system_thesis: Before testing learned LOOP policy, rank pyramids, long lifetimes, or base promotion, determine whether one frozen and explicitly game-scaffolded resolver can convert dispersed public action outcomes into fallibly self-reviewed typed connections, use those connections under a later goal, and preserve immediate registered access through two isolated per-life LoRAs without an exact cognitive verifier or outcome-selected corpus.

nodes.before: Public v03r records had no canary-specific closed cognitive projection.
nodes.after: Before any heldout model dispatch, each public episode becomes one exact E audit object and predetermined witnessed-M projection; the probe, host-only goal, vocabulary, and public DIST control also seal, and only M enters cognition.
nodes.rationale: Bind experience and every outcome-relevant public transform without private-compatible fields or duplicated E/M evidence.

nodes.before: v1b treated a provisional proposal as a mutable memory row.
nodes.after: DREAM creates an immutable audit proposal; one blind model SELF_CHECK either creates one immutable SUPPORTED row or no cognitive row.
nodes.rationale: Preserve false self-approval while eliminating status mutation and semantic verification.

nodes.before: v1b recurrence pools, counters, seeds, and states were not machine-unique.
nodes.after: One exact 46-WAKE/22-REACTIVATE/16-SLEEP prefix and matched sixteen-slot OWN/DIST branches use closed states and branch-local deterministic selectors.
nodes.rationale: Test one-hop breadth/depth growth with reproducible treatment.

nodes.before: Text and LoRA returned incomparable or provenance-bearing objects.
nodes.after: THINK0/THINK1 operate for at most twelve opportunities and receive one closed H-handle semantic read projection independent of backend provenance.
nodes.rationale: Put traversal/composition in model tokens while preventing host text from carrying the path.

nodes.before: v1b goal timing was circular and DIST/path/sham could depend on forbidden or wrong data.
nodes.after: Public DIST seals pre-goal; role/causal candidates and unique matched sham seal after goal but before any T output; correctness is offline only.
nodes.rationale: Causally test realized memory content without selecting generation or repairs by result.

nodes.before: Candidate-to-row reconstruction and fit execution were selectable.
nodes.after: Exactly two pristine per-life rank-64 fits use four exact view families, every legal question index, one shared host-enumerated two-backend candidate roster, deterministic updates, two complete 48-case fidelity sets, and atomic mounts.
nodes.rationale: Test immediate candidate-constrained recognition only after useful text memory exists, without mislabeling it open recall.

nodes.before: v1b review objects and validity routing were prose-level and P1CB01 straddled implementation.
nodes.after: Ratification releases CPU only; exact packets, fresh reviewer and advocate dispositions, and closed authority tokens gate DEV, T, L, and terminal.
nodes.rationale: Prevent self-certification, changed-byte continuation, and unregistered GPU work.

edges.before: No single M-only cognitive evidence path.
edges.after: The current witnessed M row is each WAKE trigger; E remains host-only provenance.

edges.before: Proposal and row lifecycle were conflated.
edges.after: Each new CREATE gets one check; structural model support alone admits one immutable row.
edges.rationale: Make admission fallible, inspectable, and non-oracular.

edges.before: Later calls could consume underdefined statuses.
edges.after: Only WITNESSED and model-SUPPORTED canonical rows re-enter deterministic selectors.
edges.rationale: Allow iterative connection growth without audit-text leakage.

edges.before: Reader results exposed inconsistent row/provenance fields.
edges.after: Exact one-null queries return only type, H handle, kind, fields, status, and semantic hash.
edges.rationale: Measure memory-derived semantics, not host graph transfer.

edges.before: Path/sham masks could be chosen or scored after outcomes.
edges.after: M0/OWN/DIST/TWIN/PATH/SHAM readers seal before T execution and all traces seal before scoring.
edges.rationale: Identify dependence on registered role/causal content.

edges.before: Fit data and view bytes were underbound.
edges.after: Already sealed M1_OWN rows deterministically compile into exact per-life examples.
edges.rationale: Hold write quality fixed while testing transport.

edges.before: The winning candidate had no safe full-row mapping.
edges.after: The candidate completes a semantic tuple in the mounted backend, then emits the same provenance-free H projection as text.
edges.rationale: Prevent host metadata or donor identity from carrying the answer.

edges.before: A positive plan could be mistaken for execution authority.
edges.after: Every request or fit requires the exact predecessor token and reviewed immutable packet.
edges.rationale: Fail closed at every stage boundary.

loops.before: Dedicated dreams either restated episodes or jumped directly to solutions.
loops.after: Stateless local DREAM calls traverse witnessed/model-supported rows and propose at most one new typed connection; admission is a separate blind model call.
loops.trigger: Each registered WAKE, REACTIVATE, SLEEP, OWN, or DIST slot.
reads: at most five deterministic eligible neighbors
registered focus only in return branches
writes: zero or one immutable supported row after SELF_CHECK
loops.stop_condition: End after registered slots; malformed, illegal, duplicate, contradicted, or unresolved attempts consume their opportunities without retry.
loops.rationale: Approximate incremental BFS-like breadth and depth while retaining every loss.

loops.before: Goal return could leak final answers or depend on outcomes.
loops.after: Target-absent THINK0 requests one source-target frontier or defers; zero-call M0 and fixed OWN/DIST branches then evolve independently.
loops.trigger: Both target-absent M0 corpora and the non-answer public probe seal.
reads: one M0 H projection per query
writes: M1_OWN transport corpus regardless of score
loops.stop_condition: At most twelve THINK0 operations and sixteen return slots per nonzero branch; no retry.
loops.rationale: Test thinking-to-later-memory feedback without goal answer exposure.

loops.before: No closed sequential contract joined memory and a later action decision.
loops.after: Fresh THINK1 traces query one row, think/backtrack, and commit one public token under six prospective text readers and two conditional LoRA readers.
loops.trigger: Final goal and all applicable reader plans seal.
reads: public goal and pre-goal state vocabulary
loops.stop_condition: COMMIT, DEFER, invalid operation, infrastructure failure, or operation twelve; never operation thirteen.
loops.rationale: Measure DFS-like composition by the model rather than a graph solver.

loops.before: LoRA could be trained before one useful honest corpus existed.
loops.after: A reviewed T pass triggers exactly two fixed-corpus fits, both complete 48-case fidelity sets, their joint gate, atomic recognition reads, and clean-controller L traces.
reads: sealed M1_OWN rows and exact view-instance examples
loops.stop_condition: Absent infrastructure invalidity, both fits and all 96 fidelity cases complete before the joint gate; any later fidelity/isolation/runtime failure or completion ends without refit, tuning, stacking, or retry.
loops.rationale: Separate construction quality, candidate-constrained parametric recognition, and final composition.

loops.before: Stage review and authority admitted incompatible implementations.
loops.after: Each stage seals an exact inventory, receives two role-separated dispositions, and emits either one successor token or a terminal seal.
loops.trigger: CPU, DEV, T, L, or early failure seal.
loops.stop_condition: Any missing/changed artifact, overlap, rejection, invalidity, failure, or final result stops the graph.
loops.rationale: Keep the experiment prospective and auditable.

claims.before: No v03r recurrent organism had an exact prospective causal memory-use test.
claims.after: A green T supports only that this exact game-specific ontology- and proof-sequence-scaffolded system completed the target-absent THINK0-to-return-write feedback loop and structurally used offline-correct life-local content in later reasoning on one aligned seed-5 pair under registered readers.
claims.evidence_needed: Both exact non-NO_FOCUS THINK0 requests, paired T-OWN success, paired T-M0/T-DIST loss, an OWN-only correct focus row, donor-valid T-TWIN, T-PATH loss, T-SHAM retention, correct role/causal H handles cited in later ancestral reasoning and COMMIT, complete locks, accounting, and reviews.

claims.before: Goal-conditioned return could be credited from T-OWN success alone.
claims.after: Return credit requires the additional registered M0/DIST losses, nonempty OWN focus, OWN-only correct focus-matching row, actual returned-and-cited use, donor tokens, path loss, and sham retention.
claims.evidence_needed: All prospectively fixed branch/read artifacts and the complete extra conjunction.

claims.before: Candidate recognition was not safely mapped back to thinker-visible semantics.
claims.after: A green L supports only separate 44/48 immediate registered candidate-constrained recognition and the registered own/donor decision paths for exactly two isolated per-life adapters under one shared host-enumerated two-backend answer roster; it is not open recall.
claims.evidence_needed: Two pristine fixed-corpus fits, both complete 48-case sets, candidate-to-semantic mapping, roster disclosure, atomic mounts, structurally used relation handles, paired L-OWN, donor-valid L-TWIN, and reviews.

claims.before: Paper 1 seeks reliable improvement over strong memory baselines across increasing agent lifetimes.
claims.after: Unchanged. v1c cannot establish the Paper-1 headline, learned agency, rank scaling, saturation, durability, superiority, autonomous discovery, or base promotion.
claims.evidence_needed: Later separately ratified replicated multi-world, multi-skin, strong-baseline, increasing-lifetime action studies.

acceptance_tests.setup: After ratification, validate every protocol/source/executable hash, scope, ceiling, stage dependency, review object, and authority transition.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only CPU to reviewed 216-call DEV to reviewed 632-call T to conditional two-fit L to HUMAN_TERMINAL is reachable; P1CB01 never blocks CPU implementation itself.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The canary is one immutable finite staged experiment.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate every private/audit/prose/counter/result/donor/provenance field while holding public state fixed; separately mutate the registered focus treatment.
acceptance_tests.expected: Forbidden mutations are byte-inert through later requests, rows, views, candidates, training, and read projections; only allowlisted focus changes the registered return treatment.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: No answer-equivalent or audit side channel exists.

acceptance_tests.setup: Golden/adversarial-test every kind, event-to-row projection, proposal/check combination, duplicate ancestry, lineage rule, depth, conflict, cycle, and hash.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only witnessed rows and structurally model-supported immutable rows enter cognition; no semantic verifier, mutation, retry, or audit leakage appears.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Memory admission is deterministic and honestly fallible.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise all reader queries/results, H handles, state vocabulary, four exact view families at every required missing index, shared candidates, ambiguity handling, winner mapping, and matched two-life mount isolation.
acceptance_tests.expected: Text and LoRA share semantic sources and one provenance-free thinker projection; the host supplies one sealed shared answer roster but neither model sees backend membership/provenance, and only adapter scoring selects a candidate before exact semantic lookup.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Registered candidate-constrained backend comparisons isolate the mounted memory signal.

acceptance_tests.setup: Match the complete 31-predictor vector and masks; seal NO_MEMORY, GOLD_TEXT, and GOLD_TWIN traces on six exact DEV lives before scoring.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every shortcut stays below threshold; GOLD_TEXT and GOLD_TWIN solve 3/3 paired cases with required G-backed handles; NO_MEMORY is below 3/3; all 216 opportunities reconcile.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The heldout protocol has demonstrated nonshortcut downstream headroom.

acceptance_tests.setup: Use deterministic fake providers across exact 46/22/16 recurrence, proposal admission, THINK0, M0 zero return, matched OWN/DIST, seeds, selectors, op-12, and non-dispatch cases.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every closed state, seed, selection counter, branch owner, row, handle, and ledger record matches the contracts; M1_OWN is fixed without results.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The recurrent treatment is uniquely executable.

acceptance_tests.setup: On seed-5 twins, seal public projections, goal, vocabulary, and DIST before any model call; follow the exact reveal order; seal candidates, path/sham, and all T plans prospectively; run every runnable trace; score only after seals.
acceptance_tests.expected: Missing roots or unidentifiable sham is a valid negative; otherwise a pass requires both exact THINK0 returns, M0/DIST loss, OWN-only correct focus writes, paired correct T-OWN, structurally used offline-correct role/causal handles, donor tokens, path loss, sham retention, and every gate.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: This exact prompted system can complete the registered feedback organism and causally use life-bound text memory on the canary.

acceptance_tests.setup: Conditional on reviewed T pass, run exactly two pristine fixed-corpus fits, complete both 48-case sets before their joint gate, then atomic own/donor mounts and L-OWN/L-TWIN traces.
acceptance_tests.expected: Each adapter independently reaches 44/48 under the disclosed shared answer roster; L-OWN solves the pair with structurally used required relations; L-TWIN emits donor-valid tokens; fit/read/accounting/isolation all reconcile.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Useful fixed corpora remain immediately candidate-recognizable through isolated per-life adapters on registered cues.

acceptance_tests.setup: At each transition reconcile locks, dispatched and non-dispatched opportunities, provider receipts, token caps, fits, candidates, malformed/timeouts, partial artifacts, validity, and no-retry routing.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every event maps once to the closed validity/ledger table; no drift, uncounted call, fake receipt, retry, partial fit, or wrong successor authority exists.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Reported outcomes correspond to the registered runtime and compute envelope.

acceptance_tests.setup: At every transition/terminal, give identical immutable packets to a fresh independent reviewer and separate advocate; validate identities, exact inventories, no mutation, verdict supremacy, and claims.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both approve exact bytes before advance; any rejection/change stops; only engineering-ceiling, game/proof-scaffolded, one-pair language survives; every result reaches HUMAN_TERMINAL.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The experiment cannot self-certify, drift, or promote a canary into the headline.

human_boundary.decision_question: After two new fresh-context interpretations, adversarial cross-critique, and a releasable consensus, does Rohin ratify the exact v1c protocol-lock and scope for CPU implementation; reviewed 216-operation DEV_GOLD; reviewed 632-operation HELDOUT_TEXT; and, only after a reviewed text pass, exactly two isolated rank-64 per-life M1_OWN MEMORY-LoRA fits plus 96 fidelity cases and at most 48 LoRA-backed THINK1 operations, with every result ending at HUMAN_TERMINAL?
